_comment: Symbols a launch-scope surface may import from client/src/concept2cure/v2/fixtures/. Every entry is a reference constant, configuration map or pure function — the folder name predates the de-mock work. A record array (invented projects, documents, tasks, users) must never be added here; it belongs nowhere (the sample mode that once held such rows was removed 2026-10-14). Reviewed 2026-09-20 against each export's definition. A2.10a 2026-10-26: the retired filing-catalogue fixture needs no exemption; its authored guides live in shared/regulatory/filing-lifecycle-reference.ts and the taxonomy already comes from the shared catalogue.

symbols.labeling-data.LABEL_ENUMS: Label document kinds, lifecycle states and translation method/status labels only; no labeling records. Reviewed 2026-10-23.
